_purpose: Structured schema/business-logic module for an NL2SQL prompt (mirrors bescom-ai's schema_combined.py pattern, per HANDOFF.md section 6). See semantic_layer.md for the human-readable version of the same facts, and example_queries.sql for verified worked SQL.

glossary.DCB: Demand-Collection-Balance -- the periodic financial-position report: for every tariff category in every sub-division, how many customers, what was billed (Demand), what was paid (Collection), what's still owed (Balance).
glossary.LT: Low Tension -- low-voltage connections: households, small shops, small pump sets.
glossary.HT: High Tension -- high-voltage bulk connections: factories, large irrigation schemes, apartment complexes.
glossary.DC/MNR: Dead Connections / Non-Recovery status -- installations that exist on paper but aren't actively billed/collectable.
glossary.FAC: Fuel Adjustment Charge -- a pass-through surcharge tied to fuel cost fluctuations.
glossary.ARR: Average Revenue Realized -- revenue per unit of energy actually realized (revised_arr column).
glossary.OB: Opening Balance -- amount owed carried in from the prior period.
glossary.CB: Closing Balance -- OB + Demand - Collection for the period; becomes next period's OB.
glossary.P&G Surcharge: A tariff component that only exists from fiscal_year 2025-26 onward. NULL in all earlier years is correct, not missing data.
glossary.Sub Total / LT-TOTAL / HT-TOTAL / GRAND: The source report's own printed running subtotals. Stored in fact_dcb_rollups, never in fact_dcb.

tariff_code_glossary.LT-1: Domestic lighting -- subsidized Bhagyajyothi/Kutirajyothi schemes, usage-slab tiered.
tariff_code_glossary.LT-2: Lighting & motive power, institutions/municipal premises (BMA, Urban Local Bodies, Village Panchayat, private institutions).
tariff_code_glossary.LT-3: Commercial lighting & motive power, plus permanent hoarding/advertisement connections.
tariff_code_glossary.LT-4: Irrigation Pump (IP) Sets -- agricultural pumps, split by HP band and metered/unmetered.
tariff_code_glossary.LT-5: Heating & Motive Power, larger LT loads, tiered by HP band.
tariff_code_glossary.LT-6: Public utilities -- Public Lighting, municipal Water Supply pumping, EV charging.
tariff_code_glossary.61.xxxx / 62.xxxx: Miscellaneous revenue codes -- fees, penalties, rentals, surcharges. Not consumption billing.
tariff_code_glossary.HT IPP / LT IPP / AUXILIARY CONSUMPTION: Special accounting categories, near-zero installation counts. Not regular billed consumer categories -- treat with caution.

key_columns.fiscal_year: PK, string like '2015-16' -- always sort/filter as text
key_columns.start_year: integer, e.g. 2015 -- use this for year arithmetic, not fiscal_year

key_columns.subdivision_type: 'division' (whole-division rollup, i.e. Division_Total) | 'sub_division' | 'section' (Konanur) | 'office' (Division_Office, administrative, no consumers)

dim_subdivision.notes: Saligrama only exists FY2015-16 to 2017-18 (closed, not a gap). Division_Office only exists FY2020-21 to 2023-24 (real, all-zero installations).

dim_tariff_category.grain: one row per distinct (tariff_code, description) pair ever billed

key_columns.tariff_code: e.g. 'LT-1', 'HT-2(a)(ii)' -- repeats across multiple rows (different usage-slab descriptions); GROUP BY tariff_code for a tariff-class-level question
key_columns.description: the usage-slab / customer-type text distinguishing rows with the same tariff_code

key_columns.source_row_count: how many raw source rows were combined into this one -- if >1, percentage/ratio columns on this row are NULL (see non_additive_columns)
key_columns.tariff_category_forward_filled: 'yes' if this row's tariff code was inferred (source didn't reprint it) rather than printed directly

fact_dcb_rollups.grain: one row per (fiscal_year, subdivision_id, rollup_type) -- the report's own printed subtotal/total rows
fact_dcb_rollups.note: Has the same numeric columns as fact_dcb but no tariff_category_id (a rollup spans multiple categories by definition)

key_columns.rollup_type: 'sub_total' | 'lt_total' | 'ht_total' | 'lt_ht_total' (LT+HT, excludes Misc.) | 'misc_total' | 'grand_total' (= lt_ht_total + misc_total, the true official total)
key_columns.tariff_code_summarized: for rollup_type='sub_total' only: which tariff_code it subtotals, as free text (not an FK)
key_columns.sl_no_text: the original printed label, e.g. 'GRAND TOTAL (LT+HT+Misc.)'

reconciliation_report.grain: QA table: one row per (fiscal_year, subdivision_id, metric)
reconciliation_report.purpose: fact_dcb summed vs. the block's own printed grand_total. All 292 checks currently show 0.0% deviation.

views.fact_dcb_subdivisions: fact_dcb filtered to subdivision_type IN ('sub_division','section') -- use this, not raw fact_dcb, when summing across sub-divisions (excludes Division_Total and Division_Office).
views.fact_dcb_grand_totals: fact_dcb_rollups filtered to rollup_type='grand_total' -- the report's own official headline figure per (year, subdivision).

rules: Never SUM() fact_dcb and fact_dcb_rollups together -- fact_dcb_rollups holds the report's own subtotals, mixing them double-counts.
Want a computed total? SUM() over fact_dcb. Want the report's own official/printed figure? Read the matching fact_dcb_rollups row (or fact_dcb_grand_totals view) directly, don't recompute.

To total the whole Division: filter dim_subdivision.subdivision_type = 'division' (the Division_Total row) OR SUM() the fact_dcb_subdivisions view -- never both, and never include Division_Office (it's administrative, not geographic).
fiscal_year is a string ('2015-16') -- sort/filter as text, or join dim_fiscal_year.start_year for integer year arithmetic.

Percentage/ratio/per-unit columns (see non_additive_ratios) cannot be summed or averaged across rows meaningfully -- recompute from the underlying totals (e.g. collection_grand_total / demand_total) instead of aggregating the stored ratio column.
Saligrama only exists FY2015-16 to 2017-18; Division_Office only exists FY2020-21 to 2023-24 -- absence outside those ranges is correct, not a bug.

tariff_code repeats across multiple dim_tariff_category rows (different usage-slab descriptions) -- GROUP BY tariff_code for a tariff-class-level question, by tariff_category_id/description for a slab-level question.

demand_revenue_subtotal = demand_fixed_charges + demand_others + demand_energy_charges holds on ~99% of rows (per the source sheet's own header formula), EXCEPT the Misc. revenue tariff codes (61.xxxx / 62.xxxx, e.g. '61.9047' Service Connections, '61.9067' Other Receipts) -- those are flat fees, not consumption-based tariffs, so the source correctly puts the full amount directly in demand_revenue_subtotal with Fixed/Others/Energy all zero. This is correct source data, not an extraction bug -- do not 'fix' or flag these rows; exclude tariff_code LIKE '6_.%' from any automated check of this formula, and allow a small rounding tolerance (a ~1-unit-on-2-million mismatch can occur on an otherwise normal row from ordinary source-side rounding).
